chapter: The Footlight Club and Washington friends
title: All-night playing with Lester Young, who teaches him Wilson-Holiday tunes
summary: After Toby Walker finished, Lester Young would sit with Malachi until morning and teach him the tunes he recorded in New York.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: But I got to know Lester, and from then on, after that, when Lester came in town, soon as he got off the bus he was right in this club. There were times when, after this fellow, Toby Walker, had finished playing up there and everybody would go home -- that's usually around 5 o'clock in the morning -- Lester and I would still be sitting in there until sun-up, sometimes 10 o'clock in the morning, just he and playing. Which I was happy to do, because at that particular time he was recording with Billie Holiday and Teddy Wilson and he was making a lot of those things that since then have become collector's things, I guess, or... Well, they are collectors items... But they are historic recordings, you know -- the Teddy Wilson-Billie Holiday-Lester Young things that they

recorded. And a lot of those tunes, Lester when he came down here would have just come from New York, and they'd just tunes. He would sit there, and he would ask if I knew this or this, and I'd say "No" -- he would teach it to me right there.
